_comment: Copy the 'permissions' block into your project's .claude/settings.json (merge, do not overwrite). Keys starting with an underscore are notes and can be deleted. See PERMISSIONS.md.

_opt_in_allow_examples._comment: OPT-IN ONLY. Running a reviewed repository's tests executes that repository's code. Move a line into permissions.allow only for a repository you trust. Never add npm/yarn/pnpm test, make, or anything with a bare wildcard.
